scripts.build: pnpm build:fonts && pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:website
scripts.build:fonts: python3 scripts/generate-sources.py && fontmake fonts/KhulnaSans/sources/KhulnaSans-Regular.ufo -o ttf --output-dir dist/ && fontmake fonts/KhulnaMono/sources/KhulnaMono-Regular.ufo -o ttf --output-dir dist/ && fontmake fonts/KhulnaSans/KhulnaSans.designspace -o variable --output-path dist/var/KhulnaSans-VF.ttf && python3 scripts/generate-woff2.py
scripts.check: pnpm check:design && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm validate && pnpm shaping
